Maria: Heads up — external pentest booked for May 6-8. Need an RBAC freeze plan, KMS access pattern, and an audit-log snapshot process. Can we get deliverables listed?
Jonas: Thanks — can you paste scope + assessor contact?
Maria: Scope: staging + canary services (no live writes). Read-only prod logs for triage. Assessor: RedTeamCo, contact alice@redteam.co. I'll DM creds for the readroom.
Priya: For RBAC I propose ephemeral assessor roles via short-lived SAML assertions and a scoped policy 'pentest.AssessorReadOnly' — no write or admin. Anyone object?
Ethan: Works for me. For KMS we should avoid key exports — use a KMS proxy + grant pattern so assessors can request decrypts that are logged. cc @Samir for ops window.
Samir: I can open a 4hr readroom on May 7 14:00-18:00 UTC. Ops will rotate temp keys and enable CloudTrail snapshotting for the window. I'll create the ticket and assign tasks.
Maria: Log snapshot steps (high level): run export script -> verify checksums -> upload to redwood-pt-evidence bucket -> restrict ACL to assessor role and security-ops. Add a manifest with SHA256.
Jonas: IAM snippet suggestion for the role (trimmed):
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:GetLogEvents","logs:DescribeLogGroups","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
Priya: Audit logging question — how far back do we snapshot? For triage we want last 90 days + sampling of request traces; for legal evidence maybe 365d. Thoughts?
Ethan: Staging retention default is 180d, prod 365d. For evidence export we should snapshot 365d and mark as 'evidence' with immutability flag on the bucket. Ops: confirm lifecycle rules.
Samir: Confirmed — will create bucket redwood-pt-evidence-2026, lifecycle 365d, encryption CMEK using KMS key 'pt-evidence-key'. Will also enable Object Lock (governance) for the export window.
Maria: KMS question: can we grant assessor Decrypt-only via KMS Grant during the window, auditable and revocable immediately after?
Priya: Yes — create a time-limited KMS Grant + require assume-role for the decryption API call. All Grant activity is logged in CloudTrail; add a post-retest revoke task in the checklist.
Jonas: I created ticket INC-7890 and attached the checklist + preflight steps. Assigning remediation-tracker to security-ops.
Samir: Added a fallback: if readroom can't provision, assessors get redacted logs + sanitized traces (no full PII) for initial triage. Documented in the ticket under 'rollback corridor'.
Maria: Retest plan: target 2 weeks after initial run (May 21). Pre-retest dry run on May 14 to validate roles, KMS grants, and evidence export. Volunteers for dry run: @Jonas, @Priya, @Samir, @Ethan
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll own the dry run smoke script + basic assertions.
sec-bot: Reminder — PenTest intake form submitted by Maria. Link: https://redwood.internal/pentest/12345
Maria: Thanks all — please react to INC-7890 and I'll run a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize the timeline. :calendar:
